zh-CN.title: 合并聊天记录预览更直观
items: 合并记录改为消息宽度内的聊天视窗，保留发送者头像并支持滚动
聊天中的内部合并记录可以继续预览一层，更深内容恢复为简洁卡片
广场聊天记录中的合并内容保持卡片展示，避免预览区域过窄

en.title: Clearer merged chat previews
items: Merged records now appear as scrollable chat viewports within normal message width while retaining the sender avatar
Nested merged records can expand one more level in Chat, with deeper content returning to compact cards
Merged content inside Square chat previews stays card-based to avoid cramped nested previews
